Method of Attack: Phishing via multi-persona impersonation (MPI) technique involving elaborate email conversations with fake personas
Malicious DOCX document with macros performing template injection
Macros collect username, running processes, public IP and exfiltrate data using Telegram API
Impacted Systems: Targets receiving phishing emails, including academics, policy experts, scientists specializing in genome research, and nuclear arms control experts
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with OneDrive links to password-protected malicious DOCX files
Indicators of Compromise: OneDrive links leading to malicious DOCX documents
Use of personal email addresses (Gmail, Outlook, AOL, Hotmail) for sender and CCed personas
Telegram API used for data exfiltration
